purpose: Mathematical status of the AJCR route after the separably-closed Pic0 milestone
review_route: translated rank-one charts over a separably closed field
Pic0 represented over the original field

established.statement: The good Picard locus and matching divisor locus are defined for arbitrary test schemes.
The evaluation divisor gives a natural two-sided inverse to the rank-one Abel map.
Translations of the rank-one chart cover Picard classes over a separably closed field.
A scheme and universal Pic0 class represent Pic0 over the separably closed field.

current_strategy: finite affine charts and overlap maps for the separably-closed representer
one universal Picard class on P.gluedOver
natural equivalence between maps to P.gluedOver and Pic0 families
projectivity or affine-orbit control for P.gluedOver
finite-Galois quotient and descent to the original field

open_mathematical_obligations.statement: Prove that P.gluedOver represents the finite-stage Pic0 functor, with a natural equivalence for every test scheme.
open_mathematical_obligations.why_it_matters: Compatible charts and overlap maps are not by themselves a universal property.

open_mathematical_obligations.statement: Assemble the local universal Picard classes, restrictions, and overlap identifications into one natural class on P.gluedOver.
open_mathematical_obligations.why_it_matters: The construction must become a family-level object under arbitrary base change.

open_mathematical_obligations.statement: Prove projectivity, FiniteInAffine, or an equivalent affine-orbit statement for the exact carrier P.gluedOver.
open_mathematical_obligations.why_it_matters: The finite-Galois quotient requires this property for the same scheme that represents the functor.

open_mathematical_obligations.statement: Descend the finite-stage scheme and the same universal class through the semilinear Galois action, quotient, and cocycle identities.
open_mathematical_obligations.why_it_matters: The descended object must retain the representing property, not only the underlying scheme.

open_mathematical_obligations.statement: Pass the descended scheme and universal class unchanged through PicRepDatum, JacobianData, and the final Jacobian statement.
open_mathematical_obligations.why_it_matters: A second representing object or universal class would break the intended construction.

mathematical_diagnosis: The finite affine atlas has not yet been converted into one theorem asserting a universal property.
Local restriction, overlap, and base-change identities are being strengthened without settling whether the glued carrier represents the functor.
The quotient step is conditional on geometry of the exact carrier; results for a different carrier do not solve this obligation.
Until the universal property and exact-carrier geometry are settled, original-field Pic0 and the Jacobian cannot be assembled from one representing datum.

minimal_mathematical_checkpoint.statement: P.gluedOver represents the finite-stage Pic0 functor.
required_content: natural map/equivalence for every test scheme
minimal_mathematical_checkpoint.interpretation: If this theorem cannot be stated without changing carriers or adding unrelated hypotheses, the current route needs redesign.
